title: Book 9 — Calliope, Chapter 114
paragraphs: Now the Greeks who had set out from Mycale to the Hellespont first moored their ships about Lecton, being stopped from their voyage by winds; and from there they came to Abydos and found the bridges broken up, which they had thought to find still stretched across, and for the sake of which especially they had come to the Hellespont. So the Peloponnesians with Leotychides resolved to sail back to Greece, while the Athenians and their commander Xanthippos determined to stay behind there and make an attempt on the Chersonese. So the Peloponnesians sailed away, while the Athenians crossed from Abydos to the Chersonese and began to besiege Sestos.
